title: pilosella erecta
intro: Pilosella erecta, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a perennial plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella erecta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These compounds have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-cancer activities, making Pilosella erecta a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
